description: This PHP script is designed to create a test project via the TestLink API using XML-RPC. It sets up parameters, initiates a client connection, makes a 'createTestProject' API call, and handles the response to store the project ID or throw an exception if an error occurs.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A class used to facilitate XML-RPC communication, instantiated to communicate with the TestLink server.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: A function to execute an API call through the IXR_Client instance with specified method name and arguments.
